name: Dunford’s 5-Component Positioning Framework
diagnostic: If our solution ceased to exist tomorrow, what specific alternatives would customers use, and what distinct value do our unique capabilities deliver over those alternatives?
artifact: A 5-column positioning ledger: Competitive Alternatives → Unique Capabilities → Quantified Value Drivers → Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) Segments → Category Framing.
trap: Declaring that no direct competitors exist, or positioning into ill-defined space, deprives buyers of an evaluative frame.
pedigreeFull: April Dunford (*Obviously Awesome*, 2019). Developed within enterprise technology product marketing to break corporate over-reliance on aspirational vision statements by grounding positioning in actual customer behavior.
artifactFull: A 5-Column Positioning Ledger mapping Competitive Alternatives → Unique Capabilities → Quantified Value Drivers → Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) Segments → Category Framing.
trapFull: Declaring that "no direct competitors exist" or positioning into expansive, ill-defined spaces (e.g., "the intelligent enterprise layer"), depriving buyers of an evaluative frame of reference.
